## Actions

All methods return a retainable NiriHandledReply through the shared request path.
IDs/usize accept decimal strings or exact numbers; optional values accept null.
Required booleans have no CLI-derived defaults. Optional slots before required
arguments must be supplied explicitly as null. Union arguments accept NiriArgs
values or plain objects using their wire tag and wire/camelCase field names.

## Requests

Methods accept a trailing options object with timeoutMs/connectTimeoutMs.
Picks default to timeoutMs -1 (no response deadline). EventStream observes the
session's real acknowledgement and leaves its stream open; it never opens a
one-shot socket. ReturnError expects Err and reports it through the common
error contract; an unexpected Ok is a Decode error.

## Typed replies

All 14 response kinds have uncreatable named reply classes. The result property
is typed; native result() uses the canonical C++ type. Optional results are null
in QML. The inherited value remains the QML convenience projection (Handled is
the string Handled); result on NiriHandledReply is a niriHandled unit value.
Success requires the expected discriminator and complete validated payload.
Errors retain the full raw envelope and fieldPath; replies remain retainable.

| # | Reply | Native result | QML result | Wire response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `NiriCastsReply` | `QList<NiriCast>` | `QVariant` | `{"Casts":payload}` |
| 2 | `NiriFocusedOutputReply` | `std::optional<NiriOutput>` | `QVariant` | `{"FocusedOutput":payload}` |
| 3 | `NiriFocusedWindowReply` | `std::optional<NiriWindow>` | `QVariant` | `{"FocusedWindow":payload}` |
